name: verbex-lab-tools
description: Exact wet-lab calculations, lab documentation templates and practical bench guides from Verbex.

interface.longDescription:
Exact answers to the calculations and paperwork of wet-lab work, right in the chat.

Ask things like:
• How much NaCl do I weigh to make 450 mL of 233 mM?
• How much of my 1 M Tris stock do I need for 100 mL of 50 mM?
• Plan a 10-fold serial dilution across 6 tubes.
• Make a qPCR master mix for 30 reactions with 10% excess.
• Plan an LNP formulation for 100 µg mRNA at N/P 6.
• Lay out a 96-well ELISA plate with standards in duplicate and the edge wells empty.
• I need a template for a freezer sample inventory, an SOP or a deviation log.
• How should I structure a lab SOP?

What you get:
• Calculations from deterministic code, not estimates. Each result gives the mass or volumes to use, the formula, and a check that back-calculates the answer, as a short entry ready to paste into a lab notebook.
• Plate maps for 6- to 384-well plates, protocol and lab notebook entry templates, and reagent label text turned into a materials table.
• 16 lab documentation templates as editable Word and Excel files, each with a worked example, licensed CC BY 4.0: master protocol, GLP-style SOP, protocol change control, experiment plan, lab notebook entry, deviation and troubleshooting log, risk assessment, training record, equipment SOP, calibration and maintenance log, cell culture records, routine monitoring logs, buffer and solution calculator, chemical inventory and SDS tracker, sample and freezer inventory, and qPCR master mix and plate map.
• Practical guides on protocols and SOPs, lab notebooks, inventory, data integrity and GLP, and equipment records, with links to cite.

Privacy: tool inputs are used only to compute the answer and are not stored. No sign-in is required.

Limitations: results are calculation and documentation aids, not scientific, safety or regulatory advice; scientists should check values against their own lab's requirements. Molecular weights and stock concentrations come from the user. The reagent label tool reads label text, not images.
capabilities: Mass to weigh for a target molarity

PCR and qPCR master mixes with excess
LNP formulation volumes from N/P ratio and mol%
Protocol and lab notebook entry templates
Reagent label text to a materials table
16 editable lab documentation templates (Word and Excel)

positive.description: Mass to weigh for a molar solution
positive.prompt: How much NaCl (MW 58.44 g/mol) do I weigh to make 450 mL of 233 mM NaCl?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls solution_prep once and reports 6.127 g of NaCl to dissolve and bring to 450 mL, with the self-check (104.9 mmol in 450 mL = 233 mM) and a link to the Verbex molarity calculator.

positive.prompt: help me plan a 10-fold serial dilution from a 10 mM stock- 6 tubes, 1 mL final volume in each. How do I go about it ?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls serial_dilution and returns 100 µL transfer plus 900 µL diluent per tube, tube 1 at 1 mM down to tube 6 at 10 nM, with the self-check and step-by-step pipetting order.

positive.description: Find and open a lab template
positive.prompt: I need help with a template to track samples in our -80 freezer, including freeze-thaw cycles.
positive.expected_behavior: Searches, opens template:sample-freezer-inventory, describes its sheets (sample register, box map, freeze-thaw log, chain of custody) and links the editable Excel file.

positive.prompt: Can you help me plan an LNP formulation for 100 µg mRNA at N/P 6, 3:1 aqueous:ethanol with 750 µL aqueous phase. Lipids SM-102/DSPC/cholesterol/DMG-PEG2000 at 50/10/38.5/1.5 mol%, MW 710.17, 790.15, 386.65 and 2509.2, stocks 25, 10, 10 and 10 mg/mL. RNA stock is 1 mg/mL?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls lnp_formulation and returns stock volumes 51.65 µL SM-102, 28.73 µL DSPC, 54.13 µL cholesterol, 13.69 µL DMG-PEG2000 and 101.8 µL ethanol (250 µL ethanol phase), 100 µL RNA stock plus 650 µL buffer (750 µL aqueous), mixing to 1 mL at 100 µg/mL RNA, with the N/P self-check (1.818 µmol amine ÷ 303 nmol phosphate = 6).

positive.description: Answer a how-to question from Verbex guides and templates
positive.prompt: how should I structure a lab SOP?
positive.expected_behavior: Searches Verbex guides, fetches the most relevant guide or the GLP-style SOP template, explains the SOP sections, cites the verbalexperiment.com url and links the editable SOP template.
